newsitem.title: USA: Carpenter Tech buys Global Tech for 18 mln.
newsitem.headline: Carpenter Tech buys Global Tech for 18 mln.

text.p: Carpenter Technology Corp said that it plans to acquire Global Technology Inc, a privately-held company, for approximately $18 million, including the assumption of Global Technology's debt.

Global Technology, based in Orwigsburg, Pa., is a major supplier of equipment and services for processing metal bar and wire products. The deal includes Global Tech and all its subsidiaries. The company had $30 million in 1996 revenues.
Pending successful completion of due diligence, Carpenter expects the deal to be completed in March.
